verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs describe several AI-driven insight features inside the product: natural-language signals trained on your traces, automatic clustering that surfaces failure patterns, incidents judged real or benign, and drift detection that pinpoints what shifted. For suggestions, it proposes fixes and nudges (skills, subagents, tools) that are shadow-tested and promoted only if they help, and it keeps a plain-language memory of learnings. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor-claimed), and detail on how fix suggestions are generated and shown to the user in the dashboard.
